A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a least common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that add a full denominator after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form with standard whole and proper-fraction parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for converting ordinary unlike fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Do not tag for the borrowing step that changes a whole part and fraction part during subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator, including direct numerator subtraction for same-denominator fractions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding or creating the common denominator itself.
Do not tag for subtracting whole-number parts only.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the two quantities when working with mixed numbers or whole numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a mixed-number or whole-number subtraction is decomposed into whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number component.
Do not tag for borrowing adjustments after the initial whole-part subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across whole-fraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a full fraction unit to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is resolved by reducing the whole part and increasing the fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator unless an actual borrow/regroup occurs.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and combine whole and fractional parts or convert zero-fraction results to an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when the final whole and fraction parts are combined into a mixed number or when 0/denominator is expressed as 0 or an integer result is stated.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction operations themselves before the result is formed.
Do not tag merely because an unsimplified fraction is produced unless the step explicitly reduces or formats the final answer.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as pure fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is not used to create equivalent fractions from unlike denominators.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is converted to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states normalization of an improper fraction part.
Tag whether the normalized form is then used in whole-part/fraction-part subtraction or later borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary mixed numbers that already have proper fraction parts.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.

skills.name: Represent whole as mixed
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a whole part plus a zero fraction with the needed denominator to align mixed-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d.
Tag when this rewrite is used to subtract a whole number and a mixed number or a whole/mixed number and a fraction.
Tag even if the denominator is chosen to match an existing denominator rather than found by LCD.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion between nonzero fractions.
Do not tag combining final whole and fraction parts into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole parts and fraction parts separately once the quantities are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator in pure fraction subtraction.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction produces zero or a negative fractional difference prior to borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping step itself.
Do not tag simplification or final recombination alone.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted to d/d or added to the minuend fraction part before subtracting.
Tag in mixed-minus-fraction and mixed-minus-mixed cases, including after normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless a later step explicitly borrows.
Do not tag simplification after the borrowed subtraction is completed.

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and express the final result in appropriate fraction, mixed-number, or integer form by combining whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction such as 2/10 or 9/12 is simplified.
Tag when 0/d is rewritten as 0 or when a zero fractional part is absorbed into an integer result.
Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into a mixed number or final single value.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produced the unsimplified result.
Do not tag finding common denominators or borrowing.
Do not tag mere classification statements such as Type B, C, D, or E.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that common denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions to create matching denominators
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator matching
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 4/3 = 3 1/3

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step converts a form like 2 3/2 or 1 5/3 into a standard mixed number
Tag when the solver explicitly states normalization of a mixed number with an improper fraction part
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary conversion to equivalent fractions for common denominators
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d
Do not tag borrowing after subtraction has begun

skills.name: Represent whole as fraction
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a whole-plus-zero-fraction form so it can be subtracted alongside a fraction or mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d
Tag when the denominator chosen matches the other fraction part to support later subtraction
Tag for items involving whole number minus fraction or mixed number minus whole number when the whole is decomposed into whole and fractional parts
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag standard mixed numbers that already have fractional parts
Do not tag finding an LCD unless a whole number is explicitly rewritten with 0/d
Do not tag borrowing 1 from the whole part

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted
Tag when a step performs both whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction together
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator matching or equivalent-fraction conversion before subtraction
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping to fix a negative fractional result
Do not tag final simplification or combining into final form unless subtraction itself occurs in that step

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a full fraction unit to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted to d/d and added to the existing fractional part
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction
Do not tag simplification after the regrouped subtraction is complete

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express it in appropriate final form as a fraction, mixed number, or integer by combining whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified to lowest terms
Tag when 0/d is rewritten as 0 or a whole number plus 0 fraction is rewritten as an integer
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed number or fraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step itself unless the step also explicitly performs final simplification or combination
Do not tag denominator matching or borrowing
Do not tag classification statements such as Type C or Type D
